name: AR_CMGT_CF_DTLS_GT
description: Temporary table, contains the credit case folder details for case folder creation/refresh.

columns.name: CASE_FOLDER_DTL_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for case folder details.

columns.name: DATA_POINT_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Category of the data point. Values are based on the lookup AR_CMGT_DATA_POINT_CATEGORY.

columns.name: DATA_POINT_VALUE_CHAR
columns.description: Value for data points of VARCHAR2 type.

columns.name: DATA_POINT_VALUE_NUM
columns.description: Value for data points of NUMBER type in case folder currency.

columns.name: DATA_POINT_VALUE_SCORE_NUM
columns.description: Value for data points of NUMBER type in scoring model currency.

columns.name: DATA_POINT_VALUE_DATE
columns.description: Value for data points of DATE type.

columns.name: POINTS_EARNED_SCORE
columns.description: Earned score for the data point.

columns.name: WEIGHTED_EARNED_SCORE
columns.description: Weighted earned score for the data point.

columns.name: DATA_POINT_SHOW_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the data point should be displayed.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.
